title: Missing time: waking up by a reservoir dam near Newell
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Missing time: waking up by a reservoir dam near Newell, about November 1977 at Reservoir dam near Newell, South Dakota, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Reservoir dam near Newell, South Dakota

tellings.quote: The truck is parked behind the wall of a reservoir dam near a town called Newell, more than 8 miles from their post.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels tells of two US Air Force men, Mario Woods and Michael Johnson, who were on duty in South Dakota in November 1977. He says they had an experience of "missing time," a gap in memory that people who say they were taken by aliens often describe. In his account, their truck ended up parked behind the wall of a reservoir dam near a town called Newell, more than 8 miles from their post, which in his telling points to an abduction.
